theme: ICGN wraps in Toronto; wheels up for Boston tonight.
greeting: The conference closes and you fly to Boston this evening, Dan. The day itself is light — what's really waiting is a stale December-trip decision and the Valoris agreement you promised Martin you'd read.

needsAttention.title: December break is decided late and still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p2 board task to shortlist and book all six of you for Dec 13–Jan 2 passed its decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15). Holiday inventory for six over three weeks only thins from here — pick domestic-vs-international and book.

needsAttention.title: Come back to Martin on the Valoris agreement
needsAttention.detail: On Nov 4 you told Martin Steindl you'd review his comments and the draft agreement and come back — that reply on the engagement is still owed.

needsAttention.title: Three term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Your p2 item on the Mike + Dan board has sat since Sep 25. Four kids and no coverage is the gap; it still needs a target amount and term before you can shop.

flagged.title: Valoris draft agreement awaits your read
flagged.detail: Martin sent comments and a draft agreement; you replied you'd look and come back, so the next move is yours.

inbox.noise: A Cocofloss subscription price-increase notice — nothing to do.
inbox.clear: The inbox is otherwise quiet — nothing else unread is waiting on you.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: Autumn rewards slow-cooked alliums — sweet onions melted down and baked into a tart suit the cooler evenings.

acts.line: An early stewardship call with Valoris and FinCity at 7, then your last turn on the ICGN floor after speaking on stewardship.
The conference winds down — Toronto is yours until it's time to head for the island airport.
Wheels up for Boston at 8; a note to Stephanie and Larry from the gate would land their birthdays.
